tools.name: calc_rent_schedule
tools.title: Lease rent schedule
tools.description: Build a base-rent schedule from commencement date, term, area, starting $/SF/yr, escalations (percent or fixed $/SF), and abated months. Lease months run from the commencement day-of-month with no calendar proration (warns when commencement is mid-month). Returns rent steps, totals, expiration date, and a calculation trace. Optional unit (kw, mw, unit, acre, key, room, space) relabels area and $/SF for data-center, ground, yard, residential, hotel, or parking leases without changing any number. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.rent_schedule@1, every step, and any warnings.

commencement_date.description: Rent commencement date, YYYY-MM-DD. Month n starts on this day-of-month (clamped to month end).

term_months.description: Lease term in months, e.g. 120 for ten years.

area_sf.description: Rentable square feet, or the quantity leased in unit (kW, MW, units, acres, keys, rooms, spaces) when unit is set.

starting_rent_psf_annual.description: Year-one base rent in dollars per SF per year (annual, not monthly), e.g. 42.5; per unit per year when unit is set (a $/kW/month quote × 12).

escalation.description: How base rent escalates. Omit for flat rent.

oneOf.description: Flat rent for the whole term.

rate.description: Bump as a decimal, e.g. 0.03 for 3%. Bumps compound.

every_months.description: Months between bumps (12 = annual). The first bump takes effect in month every_months + 1.

oneOf.description: Percentage bumps: rate_k = starting_rate × (1 + rate)^k.

amount.description: Dollars per SF per year (or per unit per year when unit is set) added at each bump, e.g. 0.50.

every_months.description: Months between bumps (12 = annual). The first bump takes effect in month every_months + 1.

oneOf.description: Fixed $/SF bumps: rate_k = starting_rate + amount × k.

abated_months.description: Fully abated (free) months, 1-based from commencement (e.g. [1,2,3] for three months free up front). Each listed month's base rent is zero.

round_rate_to_cents.description: Round each step's $/SF/yr to cents, as many lease rent tables do.

include_monthly.description: Include a month-by-month table (can be long).

unit.description: What area_sf and the per-SF fields measure: sf (default, square feet), kw or mw (data-center critical load), unit (apartment or other unit), acre (ground or yard lease), key or room (hotel), or space (parking). Every number is computed exactly as for square feet; the unit changes labels, steps, and warnings and adds unit and rate_unit to the result. Fields keep their _sf and _psf names: with unit kw, area_sf holds kW and starting_rent_psf_annual holds $/kW/yr. Omit for square feet.

tools.name: calc_cam_reconciliation
tools.title: CAM / operating expense reconciliation
tools.description: Reconcile a tenant's annual CAM charge: exclusions, occupancy gross-up of variable expenses, pro rata share, controllable-expense caps (compounding_from_base, simple_from_base, year_over_year), an admin fee (before or after the cap, inside or outside it, with per-line exclusions), base year or expense stop, partial-year occupancy (move-in/move-out prorates share, cap, and base by days), and estimates paid. amount.description: Building-level actual expense for the year, USD.

recoverable.description: Excluded expenses (capital items, landlord-only costs) are dropped entirely.

variable.description: Varies with occupancy, so eligible for gross-up (janitorial, utilities, management fee). Default false; with a gross-up, lines left unset are named in warnings.

admin_fee_applies.description: Included in the admin_fee base. Set false for lines the lease excludes from the fee (often taxes, insurance, utilities, or a management fee already charged).

expenses.description: Building operating expense lines for the year.

gross_up.description: Gross up variable expenses to the target occupancy when actual occupancy is lower. Omit if the lease has no gross-up.

actual_occupancy.description: Average occupancy for the year, e.g. 0.82.

target_occupancy.description: Gross-up occupancy stated in the lease (commonly 0.95 or 1.0).

structure.description: Expense structure from the lease. Default: net.

oneOf.description: Tenant pays its full share of recoverable expenses (NNN / net).

oneOf.description: Tenant pays its share of the excess over a fixed expense stop.

cap.description: Cap on the tenant's share of controllable expenses. Omit if the lease has no cap.

method.description: compounding_from_base: reference × (1+rate)^years (often called cumulative, compounding). simple_from_base: reference × (1 + rate × years) (cumulative, non-compounding). year_over_year: prior year's capped amount × (1+rate) (non-cumulative). Map the lease language to one of these explicitly.

rate.description: Annual cap as a decimal, e.g. 0.05.

reference_amount.description: Tenant's share of controllable expenses in the reference year: the base year for *_from_base, or the prior year's capped amount for year_over_year, USD.

tools.description: Recoverable capital expenditure under a lease clause: amortize a capital cost over its useful life or the lease-specified period, straight-line (declining interest) or level payment, with interest on the unamortized balance or none; optionally cap each year's recovery at demonstrated cost savings (with or without carry-forward); and allocate each year to tenants by pro rata share. cost.description: Capital cost of the improvement to recover, USD (building level).

amortization_years.description: Years over which the cost is recovered: the useful life, or the amortization period the lease specifies.

period_basis.description: Where amortization_years comes from: useful_life (e.g. under GAAP or tax guidance) or lease_specified (a period the lease states). Labels only.

method.description: straight_line: equal principal (cost ÷ years) plus interest on the declining unamortized balance, so recovery falls each year. level_payment: a level annual payment like a mortgage, cost × r ÷ (1 − (1 + r)^−years), split into interest and principal. Identical when interest_rate_annual is 0.

interest_rate_annual.description: Annual interest on the unamortized balance as a decimal, e.g. 0.08; 0 (default) for none. Charged on the balance at the start of each year.

first_year.description: Calendar or lease year of the first recovery year, e.g. 2026; labels the schedule rows. Omit to number years 1, 2, 3.

cost_savings_cap.description: Cost-savings limit: recovery in each year may not exceed the operating-cost savings the improvement demonstrably produces. Omit if the lease has none.

annual_savings.description: Demonstrated operating-cost savings per year, USD, the same every year. Give this or savings_by_year.

savings_by_year.description: Demonstrated savings for each recovery year, USD, one per year of amortization_years. Give this or annual_savings.

carry_forward.description: True if amortization disallowed by the cap in one year may be recovered in a later year of the period (still within that year's savings); false (default) if it is lost.

tenants.description: Tenants to allocate the annual recoverable amount to by pro rata share. Shares may sum to less than 1 (the landlord bears the rest), not more. Omit for the building-level schedule only.

pro_rata_share.description: Tenant's pro rata share of the recoverable amount, 0 < share ≤ 1.

clauses.description: Lease clause behind each assumption, free text, echoed in the result's assumptions so a reviewer can check each against the lease.

cost.description: Free-text lease reference for this assumption, e.g. "Lease §6.2(b)" or "First Amendment ¶4". Echoed with the assumption.

amortization_period.description: Free-text lease reference for this assumption, e.g. "Lease §6.2(b)" or "First Amendment ¶4". Echoed with the assumption.

interest.description: Free-text lease reference for this assumption, e.g. "Lease §6.2(b)" or "First Amendment ¶4". Echoed with the assumption.

method.description: Free-text lease reference for this assumption, e.g. "Lease §6.2(b)" or "First Amendment ¶4". Echoed with the assumption.

cost_savings_cap.description: Free-text lease reference for this assumption, e.g. "Lease §6.2(b)" or "First Amendment ¶4". Echoed with the assumption.

pro_rata_share.description: Free-text lease reference for this assumption, e.g. "Lease §6.2(b)" or "First Amendment ¶4". Echoed with the assumption.

tools.name: calc_debt_sizing

tools.description: Size the maximum loan under any combination of max LTV, min DSCR, and min debt yield for a given NOI, rate, and amortization. Reports the binding constraint, debt service, and resulting metrics; optionally a stress table over NOI, rate, and value shocks (max loan, binding constraint, LTV, DSCR, debt yield per scenario) and the refinance shortfall against an existing loan balance. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.debt_sizing@3, every step, and any warnings.

value.description: Appraised or underwritten value, USD. Required when max_ltv is set.

min_dscr.description: Minimum debt service coverage ratio, e.g. 1.25.

round_down_to.description: Round the final loan amount down to this increment (lenders often use 1,000 or 10,000).

existing_loan_balance.description: Balance of the loan being refinanced, USD. Adds a refinance result (shortfall or excess proceeds against the max loan) and a shortfall per stress scenario.

stress.description: Stress table: every combination of the NOI, rate, and value shocks (up to 1,000 scenarios), each sized under the same constraints and rounding. The base result is unchanged.

noi_shocks.description: Relative NOI changes as decimals, e.g. [-0.05, -0.1, -0.2] for NOI down 5%, 10%, 20%. Omit for no NOI shock.

rate_shocks.description: Absolute changes to rate_annual as decimals, e.g. [0.005, 0.01] for +50 and +100 bp. The stressed rate must stay at or above 0 and below 1. Omit for no rate shock.

value_shocks.description: Relative value changes as decimals, e.g. [-0.1, -0.2]; requires value. Omit for no value shock.

value_moves_with_noi.description: Also scale value by each NOI shock (value × (1 + noi_shock), a constant cap rate), as a lender repricing value on stressed NOI would.

tools.name: calc_lease_remeasurement_asc842
tools.title: Lease remeasurement (ASC 842, lessee)
tools.description: Remeasure a lessee's lease liability and right-of-use asset under ASC 842 after a modification, lease-term reassessment, contingency resolution, or residual value guarantee change: new liability (PV of remaining payments), liability and ROU adjustments with any gain (ASC 842-20-35-4), and the per-period amortization table (operating: straight-line single lease cost; finance: interest plus amortization) in cents that foots: every row rolls forward exactly, totals are the row sums, and the final period trues up liability and ROU asset to zero. Warns where judgment is needed. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.lease_remeasurement_asc842@2, every step, and any warnings.

classification.description: Lessee classification (ASC 842-10-25-2): operating (single straight-line lease cost) or finance (interest on the liability plus straight-line ROU amortization).

period.description: Period index counted from the remeasurement date (1 = first remaining period).

amount.description: Lease payment due in that period after the event, USD for the period (a monthly amount when periods_per_year is 12, not annualized): fixed and in-substance fixed payments, less incentives receivable (ASC 842-10-30-5).

payments.description: Remaining lease payments after the event, in ascending period order. Periods not listed carry no payment (rent-free).

remaining_periods.description: Remaining lease term in periods after the event. Defaults to the last period index in payments; set it higher when the final periods are rent-free.

payment_timing.description: Whether each payment falls at the beginning (in advance) or end (in arrears) of its period.

discount_rate_annual.description: Annual discount rate applied to the remaining payments, e.g. 0.06. Nominal: the periodic rate is this ÷ periods_per_year.

periods_per_year.description: Payment periods per year (12 for monthly, 4 for quarterly).

discount_rate_updated.description: True when discount_rate_annual was determined at the remeasurement date (ASC 842-10-35-5: required for modifications and lease-term or purchase-option reassessments); false when it is the rate from commencement (kept for contingency resolutions and residual value guarantee changes).

liability_before.description: Carrying amount of the lease liability immediately before the remeasurement, USD.

rou_asset_before.description: Carrying amount of the right-of-use asset immediately before the remeasurement, USD (after any impairment).

event.description: What triggered the remeasurement: modification_extend_term / modification_shorten_term / modification_change_in_payments (a modification not accounted for as a separate contract, ASC 842-10-25-8 and 25-11), reassessment_of_term_or_option (ASC 842-10-35-1 and 35-4(c)), contingency_resolved (variable payments became fixed, ASC 842-10-35-4(b)), residual_value_guarantee_change (ASC 842-10-35-4(c)(3)), or index_or_rate_change (ASC 842-10-35-4: not a remeasurement trigger by itself; computed as if remeasured for another reason).

tools.name: calc_prepayment_and_defeasance
tools.title: Loan prepayment premium and defeasance
tools.description: Prepayment premium, total payoff, and cost as a share of balance for a fixed-rate amortizing or interest-only loan under yield maintenance (PV of remaining payments or rate differential, with a minimum and an explicit discounting convention), a step-down schedule, a flat percentage, or defeasance (cost of the securities portfolio that funds the remaining payments plus stated costs). Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.prepayment_and_defeasance@1, every step, and any warnings.

balance.description: Outstanding principal balance at the payoff date, USD.

remaining_term_months.description: Months from the payoff date to the loan's maturity date (the balloon is due with the final payment).

amortization_months.description: Remaining amortization basis in months at the payoff date (e.g. 300 for a 30-year schedule with 5 years elapsed); 0 for interest-only. Must be at least remaining_term_months.

accrued_interest.description: Accrued but unpaid interest to the payoff date, USD; added to the total payoff.

treasury_rate_annual.description: Yield on the reference Treasury (usually the one maturing closest to the loan's maturity), e.g. 0.041.

spread_annual.description: Spread added to the Treasury yield for discounting, e.g. 0.005 when the note says 'Treasury plus 50 basis points'. Default 0 (Treasury flat).

minimum_pct.description: Minimum premium as a fraction of the balance, e.g. 0.01 for a 1% floor (default). 0 for no floor.

basis.description: pv_of_payments (default): premium = PV of the remaining scheduled payments at the discount rate − balance. rate_differential: premium = PV of (note rate − discount rate) ÷ 12 × scheduled balance for each remaining month.

discount_convention.description: Compounding convention for the discount rate. monthly (default): monthly rate = annual ÷ 12. semiannual: annual is a bond-equivalent yield, monthly rate = (1 + annual ÷ 2)^(1/6) − 1. Lenders differ; read the note.

oneOf.description: Yield maintenance.

loan_month.description: Loan month (1 = first month after origination) in which the payoff occurs.

through_month.description: Last loan month in which this percentage applies.

pct.description: Premium as a fraction of the balance, e.g. 0.05 for 5%.

schedule.description: Step-down schedule in ascending through_month order, e.g. 5-4-3-2-1. After the last through_month the loan is open (0%).

oneOf.description: Step-down (declining percentage) premium.

pct.description: Premium as a fraction of the balance, e.g. 0.02.

oneOf.description: Flat percentage premium.

anyOf.description: One flat annual yield for all replacement securities.

months.description: Months from the payoff date up to and including which this yield applies; points in ascending order.

rate.description: Annual yield on replacement securities maturing at or before that month, e.g. 0.042.

anyOf.description: Yield curve as a step function: each payment uses the first point whose months ≥ its month; beyond the last point, the last rate.

replacement_yield.description: Yield on the government securities bought to fund the remaining payments: a flat annual rate, or a list of {months, rate} points.

costs.description: Stated transaction costs, USD: defeasance consultant, legal, accountant, rating agency, servicer and custodian fees.

discount_convention.description: Compounding convention for the discount rate. monthly (default): monthly rate = annual ÷ 12. semiannual: annual is a bond-equivalent yield, monthly rate = (1 + annual ÷ 2)^(1/6) − 1. Lenders differ; read the note.

oneOf.description: Defeasance: buy securities that replicate the remaining payments.

tools.name: calc_walt
tools.title: Weighted average lease term (WALT)
tools.description: Weighted average remaining lease term in years as of a date (actual days ÷ 365.25), weighted by each lease's area_sf (weight_by "area") or annual_rent (weight_by "rent"). Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.walt@1, every step, and any warnings.

as_of.description: Date to measure remaining term from, YYYY-MM-DD.

weight_by.description: How each lease is weighted: "area" uses its area_sf, "rent" its annual_rent (that field is then required on every lease). Default "area".

id.description: Your identifier for the lease (ideally a FactLot lease ID).

area_sf.description: Leased square feet (required when weight_by is area).

annual_rent.description: Current annual rent, USD per year (required when weight_by is rent).

leases.description: Leases in the portfolio or building.

tools.name: calc_npv
tools.title: Net present value
tools.description: NPV of periodic cash flows (t = 0, 1, 2, ...; the t = 0 flow is not discounted) at a per-period discount rate given as a decimal. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.npv@1, every step, and any warnings.

cash_flows.description: Periodic cash flows at t = 0, 1, 2, …; negative for outflows (e.g. purchase price at t = 0). At most 10000.

rate.description: Discount rate per period as a decimal, e.g. 0.08 for 8%. Match the cash-flow period: for monthly flows pass the monthly rate (e.g. 0.06 ÷ 12 = 0.005).

tools.name: calc_irr
tools.title: Internal rate of return
tools.description: Periodic and annualized IRR of periodic cash flows, as decimals (0.085 = 8.5%), solved deterministically by scanning a 1-point grid of per-period rates and bisecting each sign change; reports every root it finds when cash flows have multiple IRRs (two roots within one grid step can be missed). Errors when the flows do not change sign or no root lies between -99.99% and 1000% per period. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.irr@2, every step, and any warnings.

cash_flows.description: Periodic cash flows at t = 0, 1, 2, …; negative for outflows (e.g. purchase price at t = 0). At most 1200.

periods_per_year.description: Cash-flow periods per year, used only to annualize the result: 1 for annual flows, 4 for quarterly, 12 for monthly.

tools.name: calc_lease_vs_own
tools.title: Lease vs. own
tools.description: Compare leasing with buying over a fixed horizon: NPV of each case's annual cash costs (rent, free rent, tenant expenses, and move-in costs versus equity, debt service, owner expenses, reserves, and a sale at the horizon by stated value or exit cap rate), optionally after tax, with the year-by-year tables and the break-even residual value at which owning equals leasing. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.lease_vs_own@2, every step, and any warnings.

horizon_years.description: Analysis horizon in years. Both cases are compared over this period; the own case sells at the end of it.

discount_rate_annual.description: Annual discount rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.08, applied to both cases' year-end cash flows (year 0 = closing / move-in).

annual_rent.description: Rent due in each year of the horizon, USD, year 1 first. Must have exactly horizon_years entries.

oneOf.description: Explicit rent per year.

escalation_rate_annual.description: Compounding annual bump, e.g. 0.03: rent_k = base × (1 + e)^(k − 1).

oneOf.description: Base rent with a compounding annual escalation.

rent.description: Annual rent, as an explicit schedule or base rent with escalation.

free_rent_months.description: Rent-free months at the start of the lease, abated from year 1 (and year 2 if more than 12). Must not exceed the horizon.

operating_expenses_annual.description: Year-1 operating expenses borne by the tenant on top of rent (NNN charges, utilities), USD per year.

expense_growth_rate_annual.description: Annual growth applied to expenses after year 1, e.g. 0.03 (year k = year-1 amount × (1 + g)^(k − 1)).

upfront_costs.description: Tenant's one-time costs at move-in not covered by allowances: TI overage, moving, security deposit treated as cost, USD.

closing_costs.description: Acquisition closing costs, USD (added to the purchase price for cash and for depreciable basis).

loan.description: Acquisition financing. Omit for an all-cash purchase.

amortization_years.description: Amortization in years with monthly payments; 0 means interest-only. Any balance outstanding at the horizon is repaid from sale proceeds.

operating_expenses_annual.description: Year-1 operating expenses borne by the owner (utilities, repairs, management), USD per year.

capex_reserve_annual.description: Year-1 capital reserve, USD per year. Treated as a cash cost; not tax-deductible.

property_taxes_annual.description: Year-1 property taxes, USD per year.

insurance_annual.description: Year-1 property insurance, USD per year.

expense_growth_rate_annual.description: Annual growth applied to expenses after year 1, e.g. 0.03 (year k = year-1 amount × (1 + g)^(k − 1)).

amount.description: Expected gross sale price at the end of the horizon, USD.

oneOf.description: A stated residual value.

stabilized_noi.description: Stabilized NOI the property would earn if leased at market in the year after the horizon, USD per year.

oneOf.description: Residual = stabilized NOI ÷ exit cap rate (direct capitalization).

residual.description: How the sale price at the horizon is set.

selling_costs_rate.description: Brokerage and closing costs on sale as a share of the sale price, e.g. 0.03.

tax.description: Optional after-tax comparison. When omitted (the default), both cases are compared pre-tax. Operating expenses, property taxes, and insurance are always deductible when this block is present; the gain on sale is taxed at the marginal rate (no separate recapture rate).

marginal_tax_rate.description: Combined marginal income tax rate applied to deductions and to the gain on sale, e.g. 0.26.

depreciation_life_years.description: Straight-line depreciation life for the building (39 for US non-residential real property). No mid-month convention.

land_share.description: Share of purchase price plus closing costs allocated to land, which is not depreciated.

rent_deductible.description: Whether rent paid in the lease case is deductible (true for an operating business).

interest_deductible.description: Whether loan interest in the own case is deductible.

depreciation_deductible.description: Whether depreciation in the own case is deductible.

commencement_date.description: Rent commencement date, YYYY-MM-DD. Month n starts on this day-of-month (clamped to month end).

escalation.description: How base rent escalates. Omit for flat rent.

oneOf.description: Flat rent for the whole term.

every_months.description: Months between bumps (12 = annual). The first bump takes effect in month every_months + 1.

ti_allowance.description: Landlord renewal allowance, USD. Offsets ti_cost; any excess is not paid out.

renewal_fee.description: Fees to renew (legal, brokerage paid by tenant), USD.

renew.description: Stay and renew the existing lease.

commencement_date.description: Rent commencement date, YYYY-MM-DD. Month n starts on this day-of-month (clamped to month end).

area_sf.description: Rentable square feet, or the quantity leased in unit (kW, MW, units, acres, keys, rooms, spaces) when unit is set.

starting_rent_psf_annual.description: Year-one base rent in dollars per SF per year (annual, not monthly), e.g. 42.5; per unit per year when unit is set (a $/kW/month quote × 12).

escalation.description: How base rent escalates. Omit for flat rent.

tools.name: calc_hotel_metrics
tools.title: Hotel operating metrics (USALI)

nights.description: Nights in the period, e.g. 365 for a year or 30 for a month.

rooms_out_of_order.description: Room-nights (rooms × nights, not rooms) taken off the market in the period, e.g. 20 rooms closed for a 30-night renovation = 600. rooms_sold.description: Room-nights occupied by paying guests in the period (USALI: rooms sold, excluding complimentary rooms).

room_revenue.description: Rooms revenue for the period, USD (USALI Rooms department revenue, net of taxes and allowances).

fb_revenue.description: Food and beverage revenue, USD (USALI Food and Beverage department revenue).

other_revenue.description: Other operated departments plus miscellaneous income, USD (USALI Other Operated Departments and Miscellaneous Income).

departmental_expenses.description: Total departmental expenses, USD: rooms, F&B, and other operated departments (USALI Total Departmental Expenses).

undistributed_expenses.description: Total undistributed operating expenses, USD: administrative and general, information and telecommunications, sales and marketing, property operation and maintenance, utilities (USALI Total Undistributed Operating Expenses).

management_fee_rate.description: Base management fee as a share of total operating revenue, e.g. 0.03 (USALI Management Fees).

management_fee_fixed.description: Fixed or incentive management fee for the period, USD, added to the percentage fee (USALI Management Fees).

non_operating_expenses.description: Property taxes, insurance, ground rent, and other non-operating expenses, USD (USALI Non-Operating Income and Expenses).

tools.name: calc_dcf_pro_forma
tools.title: Property DCF from a rent roll
tools.description: Property-level discounted cash flow from an in-place rent roll: each lease's rent, escalations, remaining term, and expense recovery (NNN, gross, base year), then at expiration one blended lease weighted by the renewal probability (renewal vs new-tenant rent, free rent, TI, leasing commissions, and new-tenant downtime, with fractional downtime and free rent kept as part months rather than rounded); market rent growth, general vacancy and credit loss, operating expenses, management fee, and capital reserves. Returns the annual cash-flow table (NOI and cash flow before debt) for the hold plus one year, the exit value at a cap rate on forward (or trailing) NOI less selling costs, the value (PV at the discount rate, end-of-year or mid-year), and with a purchase price the NPV, unlevered IRR, and equity multiple, with every lease event and convention stated. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.dcf_pro_forma@2, every step, and any warnings.

hold_years.description: Holding period in years. The property is sold at the end of the last year; one more year is projected for the forward NOI.

rent_psf_annual.description: Current in-place base rent, USD/SF/yr (0 for space vacant at the start).

months_remaining.description: Months left on the lease from the analysis start: the lease runs through this month (1 = expires at the end of month 1). 0 means the space is vacant at the start and is leased to a new tenant after downtime_months.

escalation_rate.description: Annual bump in the in-place rent, e.g. 0.03, applied first in next_escalation_month and every 12 months after.

next_escalation_month.description: Analysis month of the next in-place rent bump (default 13, the start of year 2). Use the lease's anniversary month.

free_rent_months_remaining.description: Months of in-place free base rent still to run from the analysis start (months 1 to this are abated).

base_year_opex_psf_annual.description: Operating expenses in the lease's base year, USD/SF/yr: the tenant pays the excess above it. Required when recovery is base_year.

market_rent_psf_annual.description: Market rent for this space today, USD/SF/yr. Grows at market_rent_growth_rate each analysis year.

renewal_probability.description: Probability the tenant renews at expiration, 0 to 1 (e.g. 0.65). Blends the renewal and new-tenant assumptions below.

lease_term_months.description: Term of each lease signed at rollover (renewal or new tenant), months.

downtime_months.description: Months vacant before a new tenant starts paying (no downtime is assumed on renewal). Blended downtime = (1 − renewal_probability) × this, kept fractional, not rounded: the suite is vacant for the whole months and the rollover lease's first month collects 1 − the fraction of its rent and recoveries (0.45 months of downtime: the first month collects 55%).

renewal_rent_pct_of_market.description: Renewal rent as a share of market rent, e.g. 0.95 for a 5% renewal discount; new tenants pay market rent.

rate_annual.description: Fixed nominal annual interest rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.065 for 6.5%.

tools.name: calc_equity_waterfall
tools.title: LP/GP equity distribution waterfall
tools.description: Split periodic project equity cash flows between LP and GP: preferred return (compounding or simple) and return of capital pro rata to capital in either order, an optional GP catch-up, IRR-hurdle tiers with promote splits measured on the LP's IRR, and a residual split. cash_flows.description: Project-level equity cash flows at t = 0, 1, 2, … periods: negative = capital contributed by the investors, positive = cash available to distribute. At most 600.

periods_per_year.description: Cash-flow periods per year: 1 annual, 4 quarterly, 12 monthly. Sets the pref accrual per period and annualizes the IRRs.

pref.description: Preferred return on unreturned capital, paid to all investors pro rata to capital. Omit for none.

residual_promote.description: GP promote share of everything after the last tier, e.g. 0.3 for a 70/30 split.

tools.name: calc_critical_dates
